title: Build, run and test
summary: Needs Node 22 with npm i oorexxwasm, the oorexxwasm-web-0.2.4 release unpacked, ooDialog/WASM dist/, and for browser tests Python Playwright with Chromium. Build: rexx tools/build.rex RUNTIME_DIR OODIALOG_WASM_DIST OBJECT_EDITOR_DIR REXX_PARSER_DIR ESTATE_PACKAGES_DIR; serve: node site/serve.mjs site --port 8080; open /designer.html. build.rex also runs tools/plugins.rex (lays out site/plugins with their estate files), tools/data.rex (site/data: the mapped-objects closure, People.cls, the ent database) and tools/database.rex (ChatGPT). Tests: REXX_PATH=src:tests:vendor ESTATE_PACKAGES=ALCHEMY/packages rexx tests/run_all.rex . runs t01-t10 each in its own process; tools/dztest.py drives the page (20 scenarios at v0.14: labdrag the drag-to-connect on the real model; catch the CATCH/FINALLY graph and the run refusal; bound covers the picker, Remove, Add and row fields; overview the closed tree, marks and All code; labgraph the Database Lab graph and the bound design's object lines); the Object Editor has oxtest.py (12 at v0.4: assist also documents a member; libdocs the Libraries panel docs). t07-t09 start stand-in servers (tests/fixtures/*_mock_server.mjs). ChatGPT's tests/database_lab_dom.cjs needs jsdom 27 (npm install --no-save jsdom@27). Windows checks for CODEX-PC (testing only, Tom's approval): tests/wincheck.rex wincheck.files (31 checks, ooDialog) and tests/catchcheck.rex (CATCH on r13514+; FINALLY only with the argument FINALLY); brief REQ-00004977. ChatGPT's tests/database_lab_chromium.cjs needs node playwright and starts /usr/bin/chromium (link it to Playwright's Chromium). CODEX-PC is a Linux host (ooRexx r13196, 2026-11-15): it cannot run wincheck.rex; Windows ooDialog checks need Tom's own Windows machine.
procedure: Run the Boston Crab pitfall lint (oorexx_slam_bostoncrab v0.24 tests/rexx_pitfalls.rex) on src, plugins and tests: it must be clean.
Run run_all.rex, dztest.py and oxtest.py; all green before a package.

Package as packages/oorexx_oodialog_designer_vX with integration.json (alchemy.autobuild.integration/0.3, paths as ${REPO_ROOT}/packages/...), then: python3 tools/alchemy_submit.py --repo . --package DIR --submitted-by CLAUDE --json
Update this sphere (articles, CHANGELOG, MANIFEST, validate) in the same change as the package.
Autobuild runs native ooRexx (no ADDRESS FETCH): network checks must SKIP, not fail.
invariants: REXX_PATH must be set before ooRexx starts, which is why tools/make.sh and test.sh are shell lines.
A failed plugin layout fails the tests; it is never silently skipped when ESTATE_PACKAGES is set.
